review.reviewer: Implementation owner (self-review against @fission-ai/openspec@2.2.0 JSON validator contract and fail-closed launcher rules)
review.decision: Proceed with upgrading pinned OpenSpec validator to 2.2.0 while enforcing all structural, Purpose, RFC-2119, and WHEN/THEN warnings and tolerating legacy >500-char prose advisories in main specs
review.notes: Verified @fission-ai/openspec@2.2.0 Validator.createReport JSON schema, exit codes (0 when valid, 1 when warnings/errors fail strict mode), and fail-closed handling of launcher crashes or mismatched totals.

evidence_limits: Unit tests validate openspec_check.py verdict classification and subprocess error handling against deterministic JSON fixtures; live npx @fission-ai/openspec@2.2.0 execution is exercised by ./scripts/check-design.sh.

cases.description: Invalid spec report is classified as invalid spec drift rather than a tool launcher failure
cases.setup: JSON validation report for the current checkout containing a spec with valid=false and a blocking error or warning.

cases.description: Launcher cache errors, missing binaries, and non-zero exits on valid reports fail closed as tool errors
cases.setup: Non-JSON npm cache error stderr/stdout, exit 127 empty stdout, and exit 1 with an all-valid JSON report.
cases.expected: Each returns status 'tool' rather than 'ok' or 'invalid'.

cases.description: False-green exit codes, mismatched summary totals, and foreign checkout roots fail closed
cases.setup: Exit 0 with a blocking invalid spec, exit 0 with mismatched summary.totals.failed, and exit 0 with root.path pointing at another checkout.
cases.action: Call openspec_check.verdict on each malformed report.
cases.expected: Blocking invalid spec returns 'invalid'; mismatched summary and foreign root return 'tool'.

cases.description: Missing or timed-out npx launcher reports tool/setup failure with exit code 2
cases.setup: Mock subprocess.run raising FileNotFoundError and subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
cases.expected: Returns exit code 2 and prints tool/setup failure message without claiming drifted specs.

cases.description: Clean machine-readable JSON report is required for ok verdict
cases.setup: Exit 0 with complete valid JSON report versus exit 0 with plain text 'success'.
cases.expected: Valid JSON returns 'ok'; plain text returns 'tool'.

cases.description: OpenSpec 2.2.0 legacy >500-char prose length warnings pass when no other warnings or errors exist, while Purpose/SHALL/scenario warnings still fail
cases.setup: OpenSpec 2.2.0 strict JSON reports: (a) spec failing strict mode solely with REQUIREMENT_TOO_LONG (>500 characters) warning and exit 1, (b) same report with unexpected exit 2, and (c) spec with both REQUIREMENT_TOO_LONG and a placeholder Purpose or missing SHALL warning.
cases.expected: Case (a) returns 'ok', case (b) returns 'tool', and case (c) returns 'invalid' preserving only blocking issues for error reporting.
